 Real Madrid apologizes to China over Kylian Mbappé's Mao Zedong dictator remark
 Real Madrid and Kylian Mbappé apologize to China after the soccer star called Mao Zedong a dictator in a viral video. Taylor Riggs highlights the financial motivations behind the club's quick apology to protect its Chinese business interests.
 Kylian Mbappé and Real Madrid face intense backlash from China after the soccer star labeled Mao Zedong a dictator. Taylor Riggs details how Chinese sponsors quickly severed ties with the athlete. Riggs emphasizes that the football club's public apology is heavily motivated by protecting its massive financial business interests and pocketbooks.
